title_zh: 67一只能寄信又能寄话的邮筒
title_en: A Mailbox That Can Send Letters and Messages
source_file: 67一只能寄信又能寄话的邮筒（7-10岁）.ppt
page_text_ocr_zh:
从前，有一只老蛤蟆。她已经很老很老了，大家都叫她蛤蟆奶奶。蛤蟆奶奶独自住在一棵老柳树的边上。
蛤蟆奶奶的儿子出门去了很远的地方，好久没有回来了。蛤蟆奶奶很想念儿子，她很想给儿子寄封信，可是她不会写字。
page_text_en:
Long ago, there was an old toad. She was very, very old, and everyone called her Grandma Toad. Grandma Toad lived alone by an old willow tree.
Grandma Toad's son had gone off to a faraway place and hadn't returned for a long time. Grandma Toad missed her son very much. She wanted to send him a letter, but she couldn't write.
summary_zh: 本页介绍了故事的主角蛤蟆奶奶，她年迈独居，思念远行的儿子，但因不会写字而无法寄信。

title_zh: 67一只能寄信又能寄话的邮筒
title_en: A Mailbox That Can Send Letters and Messages
source_file: 67一只能寄信又能寄话的邮筒（7-10岁）.ppt
page_text_ocr_zh:
那天，蛤蟆奶奶出门，她走过一个
看上去挺漂亮的绿色邮筒，她又想起了儿子，就对邮筒说了三遍：“邮筒，邮
筒，我能给儿子寄几句话吗？”

谁知道，这时候邮筒里躲着一只小
青蛙。

原来，小青蛙和小刺猬在玩捉迷
藏游戏。小青蛙为了不让小刺猬捉不到
自己，他一使劲跳到了邮筒顶上，然
后在顶上爬到下面的投递口，向投
递口里轻轻一跳，就进了邮筒。

小青蛙躲在暗暗的、暖暖的邮筒
里，小刺猬怎么也找不到他。

小青蛙躲着躲着就睡
着了。
page_text_en:
That day, Grandma Toad went out. She walked past a green mailbox that looked quite nice. She thought of her son and said to the mailbox three times: "Mailbox, mailbox, can I send a few words to my son?"

Who knew, at that moment, there was a little frog hiding inside the mailbox.

Originally, the little frog and the little hedgehog were playing hide-and-seek. To make sure the little hedgehog couldn't find him, the little frog jumped hard onto the top of the mailbox, then crawled from the top down to the drop slot, and with a light jump into the slot, he entered the mailbox.

The little frog hid inside the dark, warm mailbox. The little hedgehog couldn't find him no matter what.

The little frog, hiding and hiding, fell asleep.
summary_zh: 蛤蟆奶奶路过一个绿色邮筒，想念儿子并询问能否寄话；与此同时，小青蛙和小刺猬在玩捉迷藏，小青蛙跳进邮筒躲藏，最终在邮筒里睡着了。

title_zh: 67一只能寄信又能寄话的邮筒
title_en: A Mailbox That Can Send Letters and Messages
source_file: 67一只能寄信又能寄话的邮筒（7-10岁）.ppt
page_text_ocr_zh:
当蛤蟆奶奶说第一遍“邮筒，邮筒，我能给儿子寄几句话吗”，小青蛙被惊醒了；当蛤蟆奶奶说第二遍“邮筒，邮筒，我能给儿子寄几句话吗”，这让小青蛙听清了蛤蟆奶奶的请求；
当蛤蟆奶奶说第三遍“邮筒，邮筒，我能给儿子寄几句话吗”，小青蛙想起，他身上正带着笔和纸，甚至还有一张邮票呢。
page_text_en:
When Grandma Toad said for the first time, 'Mailbox, mailbox, can I send a few words to my son?', the little frog was startled awake; when Grandma Toad said for the second time, 'Mailbox, mailbox, can I send a few words to my son?', this made the little frog clearly hear Grandma Toad's request;
When Grandma Toad said for the third time, 'Mailbox, mailbox, can I send a few words to my son?', the little frog remembered, he was carrying a pen and paper, and even had a postage stamp.
summary_zh: 蛤蟆奶奶反复向邮筒请求寄话给儿子，小青蛙从最初的惊醒到听清请求，最后想起自己身上带着笔、纸和邮票。

title_zh: 67一只能寄信又能寄话的邮筒
title_en: A Mailbox That Can Send Letters and Messages
source_file: 67一只能寄信又能寄话的邮筒（7-10岁）.ppt
page_text_ocr_zh:
小青蛙就在邮筒里大声回答：
“当然可以，要寄什么话请说吧！”
这话把蛤蟆奶奶吓了一大跳，但她
好高兴，她把要对儿子说的话说了一遍。
躲在邮筒里的小青蛙借着从投递
口射进来的一点亮光，把蛤蟆奶奶的
话全记下来了。

蛤蟆奶奶
说完儿子的地址，就回家了。
小青蛙在
信封上写下地址，贴上邮票，
他把信留在邮筒里，自己使劲
一跳，抓住了
投进口，爬了出来。
page_text_en:
The little frog answered loudly from inside the mailbox:
"Of course, just tell me what message you'd like to send!"
These words startled Grandma Toad greatly, but she
was very happy. She said everything she wanted to tell her son.
The little frog, hiding inside the mailbox, used the faint light
coming through the slot to write down every word Grandma Toad said.

Grandma Toad
finished saying her son's address and went home.
The little frog
wrote the address on the envelope, stuck on a stamp,
left the letter in the mailbox, then jumped hard,
grabbed the slot, and climbed out.
summary_zh: 小青蛙在邮筒里听到蛤蟆奶奶想寄话给儿子，便记下她的话并写成信，贴上邮票后将信留在邮筒里，自己爬了出来。

title_zh: 67一只能寄信又能寄话的邮筒
title_en: A Mailbox That Can Send Letters and Messages
source_file: 67一只能寄信又能寄话的邮筒（7-10岁）.ppt
page_text_ocr_zh:
邮筒外面的阳光真好。小青蛙
又爬上邮筒顶，他伸伸胳膊伸伸腿，
为自己做了一件挺有趣的事而高兴。
没隔多久，蛤蟆奶奶就收到了儿子
的回信。
儿子告诉蛤蟆奶奶，她寄来的信收
到了。
蛤蟆奶奶心里很纳闷：“什么信
啊，我寄的是话，他应该说，我寄的话
收到了。”不过蛤蟆奶奶还是很高兴，
毕竟儿子知道了她想说的话，还给她
回了信。
page_text_en:
The sunshine outside the mailbox was really nice. The little frog
climbed back up to the top of the mailbox, stretching his arms and legs,
feeling happy about doing something fun for himself.
Not long after, Grandma Toad received a reply letter from her son.
Her son told Grandma Toad that he had received her letter.
Grandma Toad was puzzled in her heart: “What letter?
Ah, I sent words, he should have said, I received your words.”
But Grandma Toad was still very happy,
after all, her son knew what she wanted to say, and even sent her
a reply letter.
summary_zh: 小青蛙在邮筒顶上休息，不久后蛤蟆奶奶收到儿子的回信。儿子告知信已收到，蛤蟆奶奶虽疑惑自己寄的是话而非信，但因儿子知晓了她的心意并回信而感到高兴。

title_zh: 67一只能寄信又能寄话的邮筒
title_en: A Mailbox That Can Send Letters and Messages
source_file: 67一只能寄信又能寄话的邮筒（7-10岁）.ppt
page_text_ocr_zh:
过了一些日子，蛤蟆奶奶又想给儿子寄话了。她来到那个漂亮的绿色邮筒边，一连对着邮筒喊了三遍：“邮筒，邮筒，我能给儿子寄几句话吗？”
过了好半天，也不见动静。蛤蟆奶奶又使劲喊了一遍：“邮筒，邮筒，我能给儿子寄几句话吗？”
这声音让小青蛙听到了，他跑过来说：“蛤蟆奶奶，邮筒只能寄信不能寄话的！”
蛤蟆奶奶不信，她说：“我上次就是在邮筒里寄的话。”
page_text_en:
After some days, Grandma Toad wanted to send a message to her son again. She came to the beautiful green mailbox and called out to it three times: "Mailbox, mailbox, can I send a few words to my son?"
After a long while, there was no response. Grandma Toad called out again, more insistently: "Mailbox, mailbox, can I send a few words to my son?"
This sound reached the little frog, who ran over and said: "Grandma Toad, mailboxes can only send letters, not words!"
Grandma Toad didn't believe him. She said: "Last time, I sent my words right through this mailbox."
summary_zh: 蛤蟆奶奶再次来到邮筒边，想给儿子寄话，但无人回应。小青蛙听到后跑来告诉她邮筒只能寄信，蛤蟆奶奶则坚持说自己上次就是通过邮筒寄了话。

title_zh: 67一只能寄信又能寄话的邮筒
title_en: A Mailbox That Can Send Letters and Messages
source_file: 67一只能寄信又能寄话的邮筒（7-10岁）.ppt
page_text_ocr_zh:
小青蛙笑着
说：“上次能办
到的事，这次不一定能办到。还是
让我来帮您写信
吧！”

小青蛙拿出笔和纸帮蛤蟆奶奶写
信，蛤蟆奶奶说一句他就写一句，写完
信贴上邮票，小青蛙把信投进邮筒，
并对蛤蟆奶奶说：“等着你儿子给你回
信吧！”

蛤蟆奶奶谢谢小青蛙，不过她还是
抚摸着邮筒说：“我真想让邮筒再给
我寄一次话，我想听听邮筒说话的好
听声音。”
page_text_en:
The little frog smiled and said, “The last time it worked, but this time it might not. Let me help you write a letter instead!”

The little frog took out a pen and paper to help Grandma Toad write a letter. Grandma Toad said one sentence, and he wrote it down. After finishing the letter, he put a stamp on it, dropped it into the mailbox, and said to Grandma Toad, “Wait for your son to reply!”

Grandma Toad thanked the little frog, but then she gently touched the mailbox and said, “I really want the mailbox to send me a message again. I want to hear the pleasant sound of the mailbox speaking.”
summary_zh: 小青蛙帮蛤蟆奶奶写信并投进邮筒，蛤蟆奶奶感谢他，但仍希望邮筒能再次寄出她的话，并想听听邮筒说话的声音。

title_zh: 67一只能寄信又能寄话的邮筒
title_en: A Mailbox That Can Send Letters and Messages
source_file: 67一只能寄信又能寄话的邮筒（7-10岁）.ppt
page_text_ocr_zh:
听着这话，小青蛙笑了，他和蛤蟆奶奶咬了咬耳朵，蛤蟆奶奶连连点头，高高兴兴地回家去了。
知道小青蛙和蛤蟆奶奶说的是什么悄悄话吗？
小青蛙告诉蛤蟆奶奶：
“你以后要想让邮筒寄话的话，请预先告诉我，我能让邮筒做好准备，到时只要你和邮筒一说，邮筒就能把你的话寄走……”
page_text_en:
Hearing this, the little frog smiled. He whispered to Grandma Toad, who nodded happily and went home.
Do you know what secret the little frog and Grandma Toad were sharing?
The little frog told Grandma Toad:
"If you ever want the mailbox to deliver your words, please tell me in advance. I can get the mailbox ready. Then, as soon as you speak to it, the mailbox can send your words away..."
summary_zh: 小青蛙向蛤蟆奶奶解释了如何让邮筒寄出她的话，即需要提前告诉他，由他做好准备，这样邮筒就能把话寄走。画面中，小青蛙和蛤蟆奶奶在交流，小青蛙显得自信而热心。

title_zh: 67一只能寄信又能寄话的邮筒
title_en: A Mailbox That Can Send Letters and Messages
source_file: 67一只能寄信又能寄话的邮筒（7-10岁）.ppt
page_text_ocr_zh:
所以，蛤蟆奶奶有时让邮筒寄信，有时呢，就让邮筒寄话。

不管是寄什么，寄完了，蛤蟆奶奶都去拍拍这个漂亮的绿色邮筒说：“你好棒，又能寄信又能寄话。你是个能干的、还会说话的魔法邮筒！”
page_text_en:
So, Grandma Toad sometimes asks the mailbox to deliver letters, and sometimes, she asks it to deliver words.

No matter what she sends, after sending it, Grandma Toad always pats the beautiful green mailbox and says, "You're wonderful! You can deliver letters and words. You're a capable, talking magic mailbox!"
summary_zh: 蛤蟆奶奶在邮筒旁表达对邮筒的赞美，称它既能寄信又能寄话，是个能干且会说话的魔法邮筒。
